rep_lines.text: Hi Elena, this is Sara from HyperSale. You requested a demo yesterday—did I catch you with a minute to discuss reducing manager coaching time?
Absolutely. Before I dive in, how are your SDRs practicing calls today, and how much manager time does that take each week?
That makes sense. How many SDRs are you supporting, and where do you see the biggest gaps when managers can’t review every practice call?
Definitely. How are those gaps affecting ramp time or conversion today? HyperSale lets SDRs practice realistic buyers, while managers track improvement from quote-backed scores.
Setup for a pilot is typically light; we tailor scenarios and scoring with your team. Would a 30-minute demo be a good next step?
Absolutely—we’ll show week-by-week improvement and the exact quotes behind every score. Would Thursday at 2 p.m. work for the demo?

transcript.text: Hi Elena, this is Sarah from Hypersale. You requested a demo yesterday. Did I catch you with a minute to discuss reducing manager coaching time?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Hi Sarah, this is Elena! Thanks for calling back so fast. Yeah, I’ve got a few minutes now. Reducing manager coaching time is definitely something I’m interested in—tell me more.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Absolutely, before I dive in, how are your SDRs practicing calls today, and how much manager time does that take each week?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Sure, so right now, my SDRs practice by recording mock calls and I review a handful myself. It takes a good chunk of time—probably around 8 to 10 hours a week just listening and giving feedback. And honestly, I can’t catch everything, so there’s definitely room for improvement. That make sense?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: That makes sense, how many SDRs are you supporting, and where do you see the biggest gaps when managers can't review every practice call?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: I’m supporting about 4 to 6 new SDRs each quarter. The biggest gaps show up in their cold call nerves and objection handling. When I can’t review every call, I miss those subtle patterns—like who’s improving and who’s stuck. Oh, interesting, right?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Definitely, how are those gaps affecting ramp time or conversion today, Hypersale lets SDRs practice realistic buyers, while managers track improvement from quote-backs' scores.

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Right now, those gaps are adding a few extra weeks to ramp time. Some SDRs take longer to find their footing on live calls, and it’s tough to quantify who’s really ready. So having a way to track improvement with solid data—oh, that’s really appealing. How long does setup take on your side?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Setup for a pilot is typically light, we tailor scenarios and scoring with your team, would a 30 minute demo be a good next step?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Yes, that sounds great. Can we set up a 30-minute demo later this week? Maybe Thursday afternoon? And one more thing—can I see how my reps are improving over time during that demo?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Absolutely will show week-by-week improvement and the exact quotes behind every score. Would Thursday at 2 p.m. work for the demo?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Yes, Thursday at 2 p.m. works perfectly. I’m really looking forward to seeing that improvement data. Great, talk soon!
